title: Aureline M5 kernel-origin-pill component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the kernel_origin_pill family binds inside the frozen M5 notebook-kernel-output component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-notebook-kernel-output-component-matrix.schema.json). A kernel origin pill names where a kernel physically runs and how trusted that origin is so a pill never collapses local, SSH, container, managed, or browser-bridge kernels into one unlabeled badge. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-notebook is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
